force.description: Unenrolls the agent even if it is enrolled in a hosted agent policy or is a managed agent. Does not revoke API keys immediately. To do so, also set `revoke`.

revoke.description: Immediately invalidates the API keys of the agent without notifying it. The agent keeps running and can still send data to outputs not covered by the invalidated keys, such as Kafka and Logstash. Remote Elasticsearch keys are invalidated by Fleet Server on a best-effort basis. This action cannot be undone. Use it only for offline or compromised agents.
